title: Ahab Wars with Syria

questions.question: Which king of Syria gathered all his army against Samaria?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:1 (ESV): "Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together..."

questions.question: How many kings were with Ben-hadad?
Who won the first battle against the Syrians?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:20-21 (ESV): "...The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them... And the king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots..."

questions.question: Why did the servants of the king of Syria say they lost?
options: Because Israel's gods are gods of the hills
questions.correctAnswer: Because Israel's gods are gods of the hills
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:23 (ESV): "And the servants of the king of Syria said to him, 'Their gods are gods of the hills, and so they were stronger than we...'"

questions.question: What did Ahab call Ben-hadad after Ben-hadad surrendered?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:32 (ESV): "...He said, 'Does he still live? He is my brother.'"

questions.question: What prophet condemned Ahab for sparing Ben-hadad?
options: A certain man of the sons of the prophets
questions.correctAnswer: A certain man of the sons of the prophets
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:35 (ESV): "And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow..."

questions.question: What disguises did the prophet use to intercept the king?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:38 (ESV): "So the prophet went and waited for the king by the way, disguising himself with a bandage over his eyes."

questions.question: How many men of Israel killed Syrians in one day in the second battle?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:29 (ESV): "...and the people of Israel killed 100,000 Syrian foot soldiers in one day."

questions.question: What killed the 27,000 remaining Syrians in Aphek?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:30 (ESV): "And the rest fled into the city of Aphek, and the wall fell upon 27,000 men who were left."

questions.question: What proverb did Ahab quote to Ben-hadad?
options: Let not him who straps on his armor boast himself as he who takes it off
A soft answer turns away wrath
questions.correctAnswer: Let not him who straps on his armor boast himself as he who takes it off
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:11 (ESV): "...Let not him who straps on his armor boast himself as he who takes it off."

questions.question: Who led the attack for Israel in the first battle?
options: The servants of the governors of the districts
questions.correctAnswer: The servants of the governors of the districts
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:14 (ESV): "...Thus says the LORD, 'By the servants of the governors of the districts.' Then he said, 'Who shall begin the battle?' And he answered, 'You.'"

questions.question: Where did the second battle take place?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:26 (ESV): "...and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel."

questions.question: How many servants of the governors were there?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:15 (ESV): "Then he mustered the servants of the governors of the districts, and they were 232."

questions.question: What happened to the man who refused to strike the prophet?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:36 (ESV): "...as soon as you have departed from me, a lion shall kill you. And as soon as he had departed from him, a lion met him and killed him."

questions.question: What was Ahab's judgment for sparing Ben-hadad?
options: Your life shall be for his life, and your people for his people
questions.correctAnswer: Your life shall be for his life, and your people for his people
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:42 (ESV): "...Therefore your life shall be for his life, and your people for his people."

key_verse_text: And the king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Let not him who straps on his armor boast himself as he who takes it off.’” (ESV)
